newsitem.title: USA: Phoenix Shannon sees Q1, yr-end net loss.
newsitem.headline: Phoenix Shannon sees Q1, yr-end net loss.

text.p: Phoenix Shannon Plc said Thursday it expects to report a net loss of about $3.5 million for the year ended May 31, 1996 and a loss of about $700,000 for the first quarter ended August 31.
The company said it has received informal notices of default under its convertible notes indenture and under its senior loan agreement.
It said its board plans to schedule meetings with lenders to review covenant compliance issues and discuss short-term and long-term operating plans.
The company said that in July it had expected its 1996 net losses to be between $200,000 and $300,000.
Revised estimates put 1996 revenues at about $33.0 million, the company said, compared with revenues of $11.1 million and net income of $900,000 for the 1995 year.
Phoenix said preliminary revenue estimates for the first quarter are about $12 million.
